steps.title: Import media
steps.text: Drop video, sound or pictures here, or use File → Import Media ({import_media}). Klipp copies nothing: it reads your files where they are.

steps.title: Put a clip on the timeline
steps.text: Drag a clip from the media pool down here. Or select it and press {insert_edit} to insert it at the playhead, or {overwrite_edit} to lay it over what is there.

steps.title: Trim or split
steps.text: Drag a clip's edge to trim it. Press {split_at_playhead} to split the clip at the playhead, or take the Blade ({blade_tool}) and click where to cut.

steps.title: Export
steps.text: When it plays as you want it, export it here ({export}): a file for the web, a master, or one each for several places at once.
